scope: Full upstream WPT tree; execution inventories must come from the official WPT manifest, including test types, globals and variants.

tiers.core: P0: ordinary document loading, application startup, navigation, forms, DOM, network, session state and accessible agent actions.
tiers.necessary: P1: modern application compatibility, rendering/layout, asynchronous services and advanced interaction.
tiers.extended: P2: specialized capabilities or areas awaiting explicit classification; retained in the coverage map.
tiers.platform_dependent: Device, OS, external-service or specialized environment requirements; assess execution prerequisites separately.

rules: Choose tiers by capability and user impact, never by current pass status.
Longest matching path prefix wins; unmatched areas are explicitly marked for triage.
Manual, visual and hardware requirements are execution dimensions, not reasons to remove tests.
Keep runtime, reftest, screenshot, print and manual results distinct.
Publish per-tier and cumulative coverage; not-run and unsupported tests remain visible.
The historical 4022 executions are regression evidence, not a scope or completion gate.
